requirement_text.REQ-277: Second of three sibling page-migration requirements implementing docs/migration/decisions/0020-frontend-architecture.md D2b. This requirement covers web/src/pages/definitions/ and web/src/pages/dlq/. Replace hand-rolled tables/buttons/badges/layout wrappers/toasts with DataTable/Button/StatusBadge/PaginationControls primitives, and replace every colour literal with the matching var(--token-name) from web/src/styles/tokens.css. Both directories render JSON payloads -- disposition per-file to JsonDiffView, JsonEditor, or a named hand-rolled exception.
